_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. Each kind is called a slot. A project file records its files under the slot ids used here.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The game: its .jar, and the descriptor that came with it if there is one (.jad, or .jam for DoJa, .msd for SKT games), which FreeJ2ME reads for the game's properties. A KDDI game is one .kjx file. The files are never changed.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the game had saved (its record stores) at the start, for a project that begins from a saved game: the .zip Emulator > Export Save Data... writes. The file is never changed. Save data of another game is refused. Leave this empty to start with nothing saved.
slots.nameHelp: save data is identified by its extension, .zip.
